validate.title: Validation report · {app}
validate.meta: Run {started} · entry {url} · viewports {viewports} px · modes {modes} · axe-core {axe}
validate.failNote: Real defects: fix them before the prototype goes to review or handoff.
validate.reviewNote: The script cannot decide these. A designer looks at each one and either fixes it or records why it is fine.
validate.outsideNote: Rule checks of the whole project that failed. They are not about the screens validated here, so they do not fail this run; fix them separately or run with --rules-scope all.
validate.shotsNote: Screenshots are in shots/, highlighted differences in diffs/. After a human has looked at them, accept them as the new baseline with: validation.py baseline --app <app>.
validate.knownNote: Findings matched by a waiver (waivers.json) with its reason: known issues or outside the work validated here. They never fail the run; review the waivers when the work changes.
validate.compareNote: Compared with run {run}: {new} new, {carried} carried over, {fixed} no longer found.
validate.parity.title: Parity report
validate.parity.differsNote: The two builds behave differently here. Each row is either a regression to fix or an intended change to confirm with the designer and record.
